To serve the private forum scenario with specific append windows:

```bash
go run -tags sqlite ./cmd/goa4web \
  --forum-post-append-window=30 \
  --private-forum-post-append-window=15 \
  scenario serve testdata/scenarios/100-private-forum
```

Or using environment variables:

```bash
FORUM_POST_APPEND_WINDOW=30 \
PRIVATE_FORUM_POST_APPEND_WINDOW=15 \
go run -tags sqlite ./cmd/goa4web \
  scenario serve testdata/scenarios/100-private-forum
```

To test the append feature manually:
1. Start the scenario server with positive append windows (as above).
2. Log in as Alice.
3. Open the "staff-welcome" private thread (where Alice has explicit append grants).
4. Submit a fresh reply.
5. Reload/return to the reply form. It should say "Append:".
6. Submit another reply immediately. It will be added to Alice's previous fresh comment rather than creating an additional comment row.

Note: Append windows dictate eligibility duration (in minutes). A value of 0 disables append logic for that forum type entirely. Append permission is explicit and separate from normal reply permission.

Example of user.grant format with ItemRef:

```text
Op: user.grant
User: alice
Section: privateforum_thread
Item: thread
ItemRef: staff-welcome
Action: append
At: 2026-08-01T09:16:00+10:00
```
This requires an explicit symbolic string matching another operation's declaration (like `forum.thread.create` declaring a `Ref`) to apply item-specific user grants without DB ID hardcoding.
